# Lattice Memory Certification

Question: bound complete-string BB84 recovery when arbitrary collective encoding retains a quantum register of bounded dimension and unlimited classical information; compile the result conditionally through existing LWE-based remote preparation.

Authoritative routes:
- Continuous explanatory account: learning/report/Lattice_Memory_Certification_Report.pdf
- Report source and rebuild instructions: learning/source/Lattice_Memory_Certification_Report.tex and verification/REPORT_BUILD.md
- Learning entrypoint: learning/README.md
- Exactly 30 project-defined milestones (14 background, 16 narrative): learning/MILESTONES.md
- Single educational anchor, selected Watrous sections, notation and worked example: learning/WATROUS_BRIDGE.md
- Story and dependencies: science/README.md
- Exact models and statements G, C, L: science/model.md
- Classical refinement, discrimination, PGM identity, normalized hypercontractivity, rank: science/guessing-bound.md
- Computational simulation, pass weighting, efficiency and LWE boundary: science/cryptographic-certification.md
- Achieved strategy, logarithmic ideal-gap order, finite prior-bound comparison and resource accounting: science/lower-bounds-and-resources.md
- Analytic gap figure and reproducible generator: verification/Graph/README.md, verification/Graph/generate_plots.py and verification/Graph/requirements.txt
- Lists, tolerated errors, erasure timing and honest-noise limitations: science/errors-and-losses.md
- Noisy-storage application, independent model premises, score-to-rank transfer,
  and the companion's authoritative proof route: science/noisy-processing.md
- Attribution and finite prior-bound comparison: references/RELATED_WORK.md and references/references.bib
- Reproduction scope and commands: verification/README.md, verification/verify.py and verification/check_learning.py

Notation in the ideal theorem: n input qubits, d=2^n, m retained qubits, D the retained quantum dimension, t=n-m, r the pure-branch Schmidt rank, h the Hamming error allowance, and ell the erasure allowance. The noisy-processing application restates its own notation: k challenge qubits, n total noisy persistent qubits, D independent noise rounds and r binary Pauli-envelope dimension. Do not identify those distinct uses of n, D or r. Ideal guessing targets use delta; total compiled soundness uses epsilon, with preparation simulation error epsilon_RSP. The Pauli operators and Hadamard are written \mathsf{X}, \mathsf{Y}, \mathsf{Z}, \mathsf{H}. Normalized Schatten norms use subscript p,\mathrm{n}; ordinary matrix traces remain unnormalized.

Keep the ideal theorem unrestricted computationally. The compiled guarantee uses the imported pass-weighted simulation interface, nonuniform quantum-polynomial-time convention, sufficiently large security parameter, polynomial output length and inverse-polynomial soundness. At the storage cut, the union of every later-accessible quantum system is charged. Give refinement labels classically; apply the rank bound only on pure conditional branches. Distinguish exact-string, list, Hamming and pre/post-basis-erasure acceptance. Preparation work, physical protection and decoder workspace are separate resource dimensions. A pass supplies a false-acceptance guarantee under the model, not a deterministic count of qubits.

The sister relationship has distinct ownership. This repository owns the finite
guessing theorem and its self-contained operational application. The full
Pauli-factorization, all-cut floor and gate/interval ledger are in
https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Measurement-Free-Memory-Cost/blob/main/science/guessing_processing.md.
Both learning routes use one common anchor: Watrous (2018), with different
project-specific bridges and exactly 30 milestones each.

For that application the device receives only the quantum BB84 challenge. X
stays secret and only the basis string is disclosed after charged storage.
Unconditional average whole-string success is used. One common full-output
envelope starts at M=2n before basis-dependent readout. Independent noise flags
are proof aids, not supplied records. Every persistent controller record is
noisy and counted, and its processing must obey the permitted gate model.
Existing recovery inequalities already give the same large-block low-score
floor; low-score applicability alone is not a new asymptotic result. The score
does not verify noise/controller premises and does not automatically compose
with the conditional LWE wrapper.
